text:
razor_felix: Persistent morning error. Assumed sink_ba_ba1; actually at bathroom_shelf_ba1 on Day 15 (09:17), Day 14 (07:56), Day 13 (08:55), and Day 7. Stop checking the sink for morning queries; check bathroom_shelf_ba1.

tablet_felix: Highly variable, not fixed to kitchen_table_k1. Day 15 PM (12:40) was coffee_table_l1; Day 15 evening (18:56) was kitchen_table_k1. Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 was the only spot, but it moves. Check both coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 depending on time of day.

book_felix: Assumed couch_l1 or nightstand_b1; actually at coffee_table_l1 on Day 15 (12:44) and Day 14 (15:54). Check coffee_table_l1 for books in the afternoon.

water_bottle_felix: Assumed dish_rack_k1 or entry_floor_e1; actually at coffee_table_l1 on Day 15 (12:49) and Day 14 (14:29). Check coffee_table_l1 for water bottles in the afternoon.

mug_felix: Variable location. Day 15 PM (17:39) was coffee_table_l1; Day 15 evening (18:50) was kitchen_table_k1. Previous note suggested coffee_table_l1 for afternoon, which held for 17:39 but not 18:50. Check both coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1.

glass_felix: Assumed cupboard_k1; actually at counter_k1 on Day 15 (22:09). Previous notes listed counter_k1, cupboard_k1, and dish_rack_k1 as possibilities. Day 15 confirms counter_k1 is a valid evening spot. Check counter_k1, cupboard_k1, and dish_rack_k1 in the evening.
